versions.changelog:
- Initial release of mfz-catalogue-report.
- Accepts single DRG or DIP catalogue files (XLSX, PDF, OCR/scanned PDF, or DOCX) and generates traceable, interactive governance reports.
- Implements structured workflow for material parsing, validation, review, and report generation via MedGroup Catalogue Report MCP.
- Ensures rigorous data extraction standards; supports batch processing, review cycles, and detailed file/source tracking.
- Handles service busy states with controlled retries and clear user feedback.
- Maintains strict boundaries: only one catalogue per task, no data guessing or alteration, and clear error reporting on extraction failures.
